title: Restore Version 71 with Internet Identity Authentication and Access Controls - Frontend

requirements.summary: Re-enable AuthApprovalGate component to block unauthenticated and unapproved users from accessing application routes
acceptanceCriteria: AuthApprovalGate checks Internet Identity authentication status
Unauthenticated users are redirected to sign-in screen
Authenticated but unapproved users see approval required screen
Admin users from admin domains are auto-bootstrapped on first login

file_operations.description: Restore full authentication and approval gating logic. Check authentication status using useInternetIdentity hook. If not authenticated, render SignInScreen. If authenticated but not approved, render ApprovalRequiredScreen. Use useApprovalStatus hook to check approval state. Use useBootstrapAdmin hook to attempt admin bootstrapping for first admin domain user. Only render children when user is authenticated and approved or is admin.

Wrap the router routes with AuthApprovalGate component to enforce authentication and approval checks on all application routes. Ensure AuthApprovalGate is placed inside the QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider context.

requirements.summary: Restore SignInScreen component to provide Internet Identity login interface
acceptanceCriteria: SignInScreen displays Internet Identity login button
Clicking login triggers Internet Identity authentication flow
After successful login, user is redirected to appropriate screen based on approval status

file_operations.description: Restore full SignInScreen component implementation. Display a centered screen with application branding and Internet Identity login button. Use useInternetIdentity hook to access login function. Handle login button click to trigger Internet Identity authentication flow. Show loading state during login. Include error handling for login failures.

requirements.summary: Restore ApprovalRequiredScreen component to display pending approval status for logged-in but unapproved users
acceptanceCriteria: ApprovalRequiredScreen shows waiting message for unapproved users
Screen provides option to request approval
Screen provides sign-out option
Screen auto-refreshes approval status periodically

file_operations.description: Restore full ApprovalRequiredScreen component implementation. Display centered screen informing user that approval is pending. Show user's principal ID and provide request approval button using useApprovalStatus hook's requestApproval mutation. Include sign-out button using useInternetIdentity hook's clear function. Implement periodic approval status checking using React Query's refetchInterval to automatically detect when approval is granted.

requirements.summary: Restore SignInRequiredDialog component to prompt users to authenticate before performing restricted actions
acceptanceCriteria: Dialog appears when unauthenticated user attempts mutation operation
Dialog provides Internet Identity login option
Dialog includes cancel option to dismiss

file_operations.description: Restore full SignInRequiredDialog component implementation. Create modal dialog with open/onOpenChange props for parent control. Display message explaining authentication is required. Include Internet Identity login button using useInternetIdentity hook. Provide cancel button to close dialog. Use shadcn/ui Dialog components for consistent styling.

requirements.summary: Restore useApprovalStatus hook to check user approval and admin status with backend
acceptanceCriteria: Hook queries backend for current user's approval status
Hook returns isApproved and isAdmin boolean flags
Hook includes mutation for requesting approval
Hook refetches status periodically for pending users

file_operations.description: Restore full useApprovalStatus hook implementation. Use useActor hook to access backend actor. Implement useQuery to call backend isCallerApproved method, returning isApproved boolean. Implement separate useQuery to call isCallerAdmin method, returning isAdmin boolean. Add useMutation for requestApproval backend method. Configure queries to refetch periodically (e.g., every 5 seconds) when user is authenticated but not approved. Disable queries when actor is not available. Export hook returning { isApproved, isAdmin, isLoading, requestApproval mutation }.

requirements.summary: Restore useBootstrapAdmin hook to enable automatic admin bootstrapping for first admin domain user
acceptanceCriteria: Hook provides mutation to bootstrap current user as admin
Hook calls backend bootstrapAdmin method
Hook invalidates approval-related queries after successful bootstrap

file_operations.description: Restore full useBootstrapAdmin hook implementation. Use useActor hook to access backend actor. Implement useMutation to call backend bootstrapAdmin method (note: this method may be named initialize or similar based on the authorization component). Use useQueryClient to invalidate approval status queries after successful bootstrap. Export hook returning mutation object with mutate function and loading/error states.

requirements.summary: Restore useStaffRestrictions hook to enforce staff mode restrictions on bulk upload and delete operations based on app mode and admin status
acceptanceCriteria: Hook returns canBulkUpload flag (false for staff mode unless admin)
Hook returns canDelete flag (false for staff mode unless admin)
Hook uses useAppMode and approval status to determine permissions

file_operations.description: Restore full useStaffRestrictions hook implementation. Use useAppMode hook to detect staff mode (presence of '-x18' in hostname). Use useApprovalStatus hook to check if user is admin. Return { canBulkUpload: !isStaffMode || isAdmin, canDelete: !isStaffMode || isAdmin, isStaffMode }. Export hook for use in dialogs and pages that perform bulk operations or deletions.

requirements.summary: Restore AccessManagementPage as admin-only page for viewing and managing user approval requests
acceptanceCriteria: Page displays list of pending approval requests
Page displays list of approved users
Admin can approve or reject pending requests
Page is only accessible to admin users

file_operations.description: Restore full AccessManagementPage component implementation. Use useApprovalStatus hook to check if current user is admin. If not admin, display access denied message. Use useAccessManagement hook to fetch listApprovals query. Display table or cards showing all users with their principal IDs and approval statuses (pending/approved/rejected). For pending users, provide approve and reject buttons using setApproval mutation. Include user role display and role assignment functionality using assignCallerUserRole mutation. Add loading and error states.
Add route for AccessManagementPage in the router configuration. Register route path '/access-management' or similar, ensuring it is included in the main navigation or accessible to admin users.

Add 'Access Management' navigation link in the header for admin users. Use useApprovalStatus hook to check isAdmin and conditionally render the navigation item. Link should navigate to the AccessManagementPage route.

requirements.summary: Re-enable authentication and approval checks in all mutation operations across frontend dialogs
acceptanceCriteria: All create/edit/delete dialogs check useMutationGate for actor readiness and authentication
Dialogs show SignInRequiredDialog when mutations are blocked due to missing authentication
Mutation buttons are disabled when user lacks required permissions

file_operations.description: Restore full useMutationGate hook implementation to enforce authentication checks. Use useActor hook to check actor availability. Use useInternetIdentity hook to check authentication status. Return { canMutate: !!actor && !!identity, isAuthenticated: !!identity, actorReady: !!actor, blockingReason } where blockingReason explains why mutations are blocked (e.g., 'Not authenticated', 'Backend not connected'). Export hook for use in all mutation dialogs.

Integrate useMutationGate hook to check authentication before enabling form submission. Show SignInRequiredDialog when canMutate is false due to authentication. Disable submit button when mutations are blocked. Display inline message explaining why submission is disabled when applicable.

Integrate useMutationGate hook to check authentication before enabling challan creation. Show SignInRequiredDialog when user is not authenticated and attempts to submit. Disable create button based on canMutate flag. Add local state to control SignInRequiredDialog visibility.

Integrate useMutationGate hook to check authentication before enabling challan updates. Show SignInRequiredDialog when mutations are blocked. Disable save button when canMutate is false. Include authentication check in dialog open logic.

Integrate useMutationGate hook to check authentication before enabling payment creation. Show SignInRequiredDialog component when user attempts mutation without authentication. Disable submit button based on canMutate status.

Integrate useMutationGate hook to check authentication before enabling petty cash record creation or updates. Show SignInRequiredDialog when mutations are blocked due to missing authentication. Disable form submission based on canMutate flag.

Integrate useMutationGate hook and useStaffRestrictions hook to enforce authentication and staff restrictions for bulk uploads. Disable upload button when canMutate is false or canBulkUpload is false. Show SignInRequiredDialog when authentication is required. Display staff restriction message when applicable.

Integrate useMutationGate hook and useStaffRestrictions hook. Enforce authentication checks and staff mode restrictions for new format bulk uploads. Show SignInRequiredDialog when needed. Disable upload functionality based on permission checks.

Integrate useMutationGate hook and useStaffRestrictions hook to enforce authentication and staff restrictions for date restoration. Show SignInRequiredDialog when mutations require authentication. Disable restore functionality when permissions are insufficient.

Integrate useMutationGate hook and useStaffRestrictions hook to enforce authentication and staff restrictions for client bulk uploads. Show SignInRequiredDialog when needed. Disable bulk upload based on canMutate and canBulkUpload flags.

Integrate useMutationGate hook and useStaffRestrictions hook to enforce authentication and staff restrictions for inventory bulk uploads. Show SignInRequiredDialog when mutations are blocked. Disable upload based on permission checks.

Integrate useMutationGate hook and useStaffRestrictions hook to enforce authentication and staff restrictions for payment bulk uploads. Show SignInRequiredDialog when authentication is missing. Disable bulk upload functionality when canMutate or canBulkUpload is false.

Integrate useMutationGate hook and useStaffRestrictions hook to enforce authentication and staff restrictions for petty cash bulk uploads. Show SignInRequiredDialog when needed. Disable upload based on permission checks.

requirements.summary: Remove all features, functions, formulas, and UI changes that were added or modified between version 71 and version 77, preserving only version 71 functionality (frontend changes only)
acceptanceCriteria: Application functionality matches version 71 exactly
No version 77 features remain in the frontend codebase
All authentication and access control logic from v71 is restored

file_operations.description: Review ChallansPage and remove any features added after version 71. Ensure authentication checks are enforced using AuthApprovalGate wrapper. Restore staff restriction checks for bulk operations. Verify that all mutation actions require authentication and approval.

Review InventoryPage and remove any features added after version 71. Ensure authentication checks are enforced. Restore staff restriction checks for bulk uploads and delete operations. Verify page matches version 71 functionality.

Review PaymentsPage and remove any features added after version 71. Ensure authentication checks are enforced. Restore staff restriction checks for bulk operations. Verify page matches version 71 functionality.

Review PettyCashPage and remove any features added after version 71. Ensure authentication checks are enforced. Restore staff restriction checks for bulk uploads. Verify page matches version 71 functionality.
Review DashboardPage and remove any features or metrics added after version 71. Ensure authentication checks are enforced via AuthApprovalGate. Verify dashboard content matches version 71 exactly.
Review ReportsPage and remove any features added after version 71. Ensure authentication checks are enforced. Verify report generation and filtering matches version 71 functionality.
Review ClientBalancesPage and remove any features added after version 71. Ensure authentication checks are enforced via AuthApprovalGate. Verify client balance calculations match version 71.
